name: connexion-ide
description: Local Zaalis IDE with an Express server, CLI, and native Windows shell.

scripts.build:server: npm run check:mojibake && pkg . --targets node22-win-x64 --no-bytecode --public --output native/dist/zaalis-server.exe
scripts.build:rust: cargo build --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --workspace --release && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/stage-rust-binaries.ps1
scripts.build:cli: cargo build --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --release -p zaalis-cli -p zaalis-agentd && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/stage-rust-binaries.ps1
